product_metadata.title: South Shore Primo 6-Drawer Double Dresser-Pure Black
features: PURITY OF DESIGN: Primo collection is all about the premium feel - every part of this double dresser has been carefully designed to pure perfection.
MODERN FEATURES: This double dresser features metal handles, a cutout kickplate and metal drawer slides all wrapped in clean and simple lines that make Primo Collection so special.

STORE IN STYLE: With its 6 deep drawers, this double dresser provides plenty of storage room for your clothes, sheets, accessories and other personal belongings. The spacious top is suitable for decorations and items you need within your arm's reach.
This dresser is manufactured in North America from certified Environmentally Preferred laminated particle panels.
5-YEAR LIMITED : Shop with confidence knowing that we proudly stand behind this dresser with a full 5-year limited . Assembly is required.
description: Contemporary Lines And FinishThis Primo 6-drawer dresser has a timeless look and blends in easily with any decor. The contemporary lines are softened by the curved kick plate, and metal handles add character and value to the furniture. The neutral, modern style makes it suitable for men’s, women’s or kids bedrooms, providing plenty of storage space in this attractive piece of furniture. Practical Storage And OrganizationWith large drawers, this dresser from the Primo Collection was designed just for tighter spaces! Featuring 6 large drawers with detailed metal handles, the dresser provides plenty of room for clothes, linens or general storage keeping your space organized and neat. Included with metal slides for easy and quiet use, there's no wrestling required to access your belongings. 5-Year Limited Shop with confidence knowing that we proudly stand behind this Primo Double Dresser with a full 5-year limited . Assembly is required. The packaging is tested and certified to reduce the risk of damage during shipment. We recommend 2 people to assemble. The back is not laminated and the accessories are not included. Made in North America with non-toxic laminated particleboard. Wipe clean with a dry cloth. South Shore Furniture's support team is available 7 days a week if you have any questions.
